name: Muicinis
text: Muicinis is a name meaning pig island. Geoffrey Keating applies it to Ireland in his 17th-century history of the country.

attributes.attribute: name for Ireland in Keating's 17th-century history

okr.objective: Documents Muicinis as recorded in MacKillop 2008 for the Public Celtic Encyclopedia.
key_results: Keating's 17th-century history uses it as a name for Ireland.
